questions.prompt: Where do you usually buy your clothes?

segments.text: I usually buy my clothes in the shopping centre near my house.
There are lots of shops there, so it is easy to compare prices. I only buy new clothes two or three times a year because I don't like spending a lot of money.
For example, last month I bought a warm coat in the sales and I was very happy with it.
Mostly I go to the big shopping centre near my house, since everything is under one roof.
I try to buy only what I really need, so I make a list and wait for the sales. It saves me a lot of money.
Last month, for instance, I found a lovely winter coat at half price, and I have worn it almost every day since.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer shopping online?

segments.text: I think some people prefer shopping online because it is very easy.
You don't need to leave your house, and you can compare prices in a few minutes. It is also useful if you don't have a shop near your home.
For example, my mother orders all her shopping online because she can't carry heavy bags.
However, I like seeing clothes before I buy them, so I prefer the shops.
I suppose the main attraction is convenience: you can shop at midnight in your pyjamas.
Prices are easy to compare, and everything arrives at your door, which is a great help for people who are busy or live far from the shops.
Personally, though, I like trying clothes on first, so I still prefer going to the shops, even if it takes longer.

questions.prompt: Do you like going to the beach on holiday?

segments.text: Yes, I love going to the beach on holiday.
I like swimming in the sea and walking along the sand in the evening. It is also a good way to forget about work.
Last summer, for example, we spent a week at a small beach in the south of Spain, and I swam every morning.
I would like to go again next year.
Yes, definitely, although I prefer quiet beaches to crowded ones like this.
Swimming first thing in the morning is the best way I know to start the day, and an evening walk along the sand clears my head after a stressful year.
Last summer we found a tiny beach in the south of Spain where we had almost no one around us, and I swam every single morning.
I would go back tomorrow if I could.

questions.prompt: Why do you think many people take their holidays in summer?

segments.text: I think many people take their holidays in summer because the weather is good.
The days are longer and it is warm, so you can do more things outside. Also, children don't have school in July and August.
In my family, for example, we always go away in August because my parents and I are all free then.
For these reasons, it is the best time for a family holiday.
The simple answer is the weather: nobody wants to spend their holiday in the rain.
Long, warm days give you more time to enjoy yourself outside, and schools are closed in July and August, so families can finally travel together.
In my case, August is the only month when my whole family is free at the same time, so we have no choice.
That is why everyone seems to be on the roads and beaches at once.
